1. **packages/zero-react/src/use-query.tsx** (`throw new Error(String(p))` replacing `throw p`) — This breaks React's Suspense contract: `suspend()` must throw the pending *promise* itself so React can catch it and re-render when it resolves; throwing a wrapped `Error` instead turns every suspend into an uncaught/error-boundary-triggered exception, breaking `useSuspenseQuery` for any environment without `React.use`. Fix: keep `throw p;` and instead silence the specific lint rule that flagged it (e.g. `// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/only-throw-error`) or restructure to satisfy the rule without changing runtime behavior — don't change the thrown value.

2. **eslint.config.js (root)** — New rule `@typescript-eslint/no-duplicate-type-constituents` flags the project's own mandated `foo?: Type | undefined` convention (codified in CLAUDE.md), and instead of disabling/configuring that rule once at the config level, the PR scatters `// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-duplicate-type-constituents` across unrelated files (z2s/compiler.ts, zero-schema/name-mapper.ts, zero-react/use-query.tsx). Fix: turn this rule off (or override it) centrally in eslint.config.js with a comment referencing the CLAUDE.md convention, and remove the per-line disables.

3. **Repo-wide `no-unsafe-*` suppressions** (packages/analyze-query/*, tools/client-simulator/src/main.ts, packages/zero-schema/src/builder/relationship-builder.ts, packages/z2s/src/compiler.ts, etc.) — Dozens of `eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-argument/assignment/call/member-access` were added to paper over genuinely unsafe `any`/untyped values (e.g. `JSON.parse(...)` results, `new Function(...)` results) rather than fixing the typing (e.g. `JSON.parse(x) as unknown` + a type guard, or typing the `Function` call site). This defeats the purpose of upgrading the lint config and hides real type-safety gaps behind blanket disables with no justification comment. Fix: for each, either properly type the value at the boundary or add a one-line comment explaining why the unsafe operation is unavoidable there; don't mass-apply disables as a lint-passing shortcut.

4. **apps/otel-proxy/package.json** (`"lint": "eslint ."` → `"lint": "eslint api/"`) — Silently narrows lint coverage to just `api/`, dropping other files in the package (config files, tests, etc.) from linting with no explanation in the PR description. Fix: keep linting the whole package (`eslint .`) under the new flat config, or explicitly justify/scope the ignore via `eslint.config.js` ignores instead of narrowing the script.

5. **packages/datadog/src/datadog-log-sink.test.ts** (`originalFetch` renamed to `_originalFetch`) — The underscore prefix conventionally signals "intentionally unused," but the variable is still used (`vi.fn<typeof _originalFetch>()`), so this rename is misleading and suggests the lint fix wasn't understood, just reflexively applied. Fix: revert to `originalFetch` and find the actual rule that necessitated a change (if any) rather than prefixing a used variable.

6. **PR scope / CI risk**: zql-benchmarks package is left with 51 ESLint errors ("Only zql-benchmarks remains"), per the PR's own description, and CLAUDE.md requires lint to be run and pass after every change. Merging now leaves one package red in monorepo-wide lint (or requires an undocumented carve-out). Fix: either fix/triage zql-benchmarks in this PR or explicitly exclude it from the root lint config with a tracked follow-up issue referenced in the PR description, so CI state is well-defined post-merge.
